save.text: Sam absent tonight; Scanlan played by Keyleth and Percy; Pike absent in New York; Patrick Rothfuss joining via Skype.
Lootcrate sponsorship announced; January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off; link lootcrate.com/criticalrole.
Blue Microphones provided new audio equipment; site bluemic.com mentioned.

Vox Machina's recent battle: defeated Thordak; Raishan stole Thordak's corpse and two eggs; Raishan located on a southern Lucidian Ocean island (former Thordak lair/Opash's domain); group rested and regained resources; Scanlan, Percy, Pike leveled.
Lootcrate sponsorship announced earlier; January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off; link lootcrate.com/criticalrole.

Party redistributed magic items: boots returned to Percy's request; Dwarven Thrower (warhammer) found — +3, thrown (20/60), +1d8 damage (2d8 vs Giants), returns after throw, requires attunement by a dwarf.
Dwarven Thrower (hammer) can be attuned if wearing Belt of Dwarvenkind; unattuning belt forces unattuning hammer. Grog chooses to attune Dwarven Thrower and drop Blood Axe. (turns 99,153-156)

Boots of Elvenkind found; do not require attunement and will replace Pike's Sprinter's Boots if worn. Sprinter's Boots do require attunement; changing boots is not instantaneous. (turns 108-116,122-126)
Deathwalker's Ward being attuned to necrotic by Percy (Liam). (turn 127-128)
Grog pulled a cursed scimitar from Bag of Holding causing a headache; curse expended but Grog permanently -2 to all saving throws until a god removes it. (turns 175-206)
Pike (Laura) intends to try Greater Restoration (5th-level) on Grog to remove curse/headache. (turns 226-231,244)
Keyleth (Marisha) offered Grog her Ring of Protection +2 (would add +2 AC and +2 to all saves) but Grog declined due to attunement. (turns 237-243)
Pike cast Greater Restoration (5th-level) on Grog but it failed to remove the headache/curse (turn 245).

Pike cast Heroes' Feast (6th-level) feeding party and allies; everyone gained +15 max HP and immunity to poison and fear; affects up to 12 including Kerr, Allura, Kima, Trinket (turns 296-304,300-306,301).
Vax (Kerr) accepted cloak of displacement and a Ring of Invisibility loaned by Vax; Kerr is wearing chainmail so bracers of defense won't work (turns 258-266,261-263,259).

Party plans to assault Opash's cave; debate whether to scry or teleport. Marisha can Transport Via Plants to teleport group (lesser power than Teleport). Kima/Allura will accompany and have Heroes' Feast benefits. Leave a Gate Stone with Cassandra; Kima took it to deliver. (turns 315-387)
Grog found and collected three quartz-like rocks near road/castle exterior; one basketball-sized; put into Bag of Holding. (turns 342,351,354)
Allura appears hardened/dark; wearing ceremonial robes with runes on staff and extra rings; prepared for battle. Kima fully armored and arriving to assist. (turns 359-366,373-374)

Party used Sun Tree portal (Keyleth leading) to reach island/jungle near mountain with radial blight centered on mountain; Pass Without a Trace cast before entry; group observed trees withered black nearer mountain. (turns 401-432,431-434)
Allura (hood up) accompanied group; acknowledged Sun Tree beginning to regrow; expressed hope to return victorious. (turns 401,403)
Scanlan (Taliesin) present, feeling unwell/cold; joked about being terrible plan and sang a bit; others noticed his changed demeanor. (turns 413-418,424-427)

Party used Sun Tree portal to island/jungle near mountain with radial blight centered on mountain; Pass Without a Trace active; trees near mountain petrified/dead for hundreds of years, not recent scarring. (turns 401,461,489-504,499)
Scanlan (Taliesin) present and rolled high Stealth (31); Scanlan noted changed demeanor earlier. (turns 468,413)
Allura researched island: indigenous people disappeared after Opash settled; island considered cursed; scavengers rarely return; Opash's lair may be well-protected/arcane. (turn 524,527)

Party approached mountain; ground has multiple hollow-earth sinkhole-like magical patches (10-15 ft ovals) that grow denser closer to mountain; throwing a rock into a patch caused it to sink/disappear (turns 575-597).

Allura/Kima/Drake/Raishan backstory: gem in Thordak's chest likely created by Vex/Kima/Drake; Raishan possibly responsible for embedding it during Plane of Fire rituals with Fire Ashari—details uncertain; party must find cave (turns 532-535,533).
Vax and Vex scouting ahead; Vax nearly stepped into different-texture ground (detected by Vex); Investigation checks: Vex 26, Vax 18 (turns 537-542,545).

Party found large boulder (20-30 ft) jammed into a cavern entrance ~200 ft from their landing; boulder shows clustered claw marks from a very large dragon and has been placed/removed many times. (turns 620,640)
Holes (~> coin-sized) pepper rock surface near entrance; appear to be claw-made intrusions clustered around boulder. (turns 623-626,640)
Marisha (Keyleth) offers to Stone Shape seam of boulder to create an entry; party debated recon vs immediate entry; scrying considered. (turns 645-656,667-670)
Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness used: Patrick detected three dragon life forces within ~1 mile/direction of mountain below boulder (turns 679-682).
Vex and Grog trade: Grog offers a Parapet of Wound Closure (non-attunement) to Vex; Vex gives a pouch-shaped case and takes Grog's necklace/cards; Grog promises not to open the pouch (turns 715-744).
Clarification on Detect/Divine Sense ranges: Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness noted as 1 mile duration 1 min/level; here detection confirms sources within one mile (turns 688-692).
Vex returned Grog's deck; trade completed; Grog promised not to look while Vex nearby (turns 752-770, 776-779).

Keyleth used Stone Shape (4th-level) to make ~5-ft-thick tunnel crack into mountain; created small opening allowing arm reach and line-of-sight ~100 ft into dark curved tunnel with undisturbed dust; no immediate signs of movement (turns 784-800, 801-806).

Laura fired an Oracle Arrow through the new opening; it traveled ~100 ft, landed and provided vision showing pitch-black tunnel curving left and descending; heavy dust, likely no recent traffic (turn 796-800, 801).

Discussion of methods to enter behind boulder: options considered—Stone Shape already used; Keyleth suggested another Stone Shape to carve a finger-width section (Patrick/Rothfuss suggested) but would cost another spell slot (turns 846-852).
Percy (Liam) offered Oil of Etherealness to send someone (Scanlan/Pike) through rock; not enough to cover Percy himself; idea considered as reconnaissance (turns 853-861).
Investigation by Grog/Travis: roll 17 revealed dragon-sized fingerholds and no mechanical switch; suggests boulder was jammed by creature, not a smooth natural cork (turns 865-869).

Group leveraged boulder ~1.5 ft; Pike aided Grog (advantage). Immovable Rods jammed into dragon-made finger-holes to hold boulder; each rod holds 8,000 lbs; boulder currently stationary but slowly moving. (turns 894-921)
Party entered tunnel: 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved passage; floor dust, smell of rot/stagnant water; no airflow; still and untouched in this section. (turns 931-933)
Tunnel floor has scattered bone shards, many charred/blackened; pieces range pebble to die-size. Vax recognized bone from prior subterranean location. (turns 942-947)
Group rerolled stealth; individual stealth results: Grog? (Travis) 28->30, Vex 34, Percy 35, Keyleth 30, Scanlan 18, Pike 25, Patrick(Rothfuss) 29. (turns 965-975,971-975)
Bones in tunnel assessed by Keyleth: charred years old (not ancient), layer of dust indicates untouched for a short time. (turns 977-982,979-980)
Pike cast Death Ward on Vex (4th-level spell); duration 8 hours; Vex will be brought to 1 HP instead of 0 once. (turns 991-1000)

Kerrek (Patrick) held a dagger emitting flame functioning as a light source (~15 ft candle-equivalent); if drawn, Kerrek can see ~60 ft otherwise 15 ft; Matt clarified darkvision interactions. (turns 1033-1072)

While moving down tunnel they passed alcoves/shelves every ~20 ft containing candles, skulls, small books, wooden box (untrapped by Investigation 22) and a mummified raccoon-like corpse on a shelf. (turns 1054-1061,1064-1065,1069-1096)
Group proceeded stealthily linking arms; Kerrek felt ground shift and was pulled close by a heavy arm (Grog) as party continued quietly. (turns 1042-1046,1051-1053)

Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness: Patrick used it and detected an undead presence (not directionally precise initially); later clarified it gives type and location if not behind total cover — here undead located to the left wall shelf (turns 1102-1109,1123-1126).
Skull on left shelf: two mostly melted candles and a dust-covered human skull with slight blackened/singed bone; Grog moved toward it and picked it up to hand to Kerr. (turns 1136-1149,1161-1162).

Undead nature: Matt judged the undead presence not extremely powerful (no lich/orcus); Patrick's religion check (12) suggested undead magic could raise/control dead; possible situational uses (watcher/spy/trigger) discussed. (turns 1109,1156-1159,1160).
Patrick used Divine Sense and identified a skull as the source of undead energy; skull not reacting while held. Group decided to bag it and set it facing wall. (turns 1164-1191)

Chamber beyond tunnel: hexagonal chamber ~25 ft high, central dark-green marble pillar ~10 ft with an iron bowl on top (5-6 ft high platform); large iron door seals chamber; shelf with large leather-bound tome and unlit cold iron brazier with tinder. (turns 1199-1210)
Multiple perception checks: party sees no other creatures; Divine Sense found no undead within 60 ft. (turns 1226-1230)

Chamber encountered beyond gate: central iron bowl on pillar with faint dried dark burgundy residue—tastes iron-like (blood). Large iron door on far wall; no visible mechanical fittings; smooth seam. (turns 1236-1246,1258-1266,1282-1289)
Kerrek (half-elf rogue) revealed large jet-black raven-like wings from shoulderblades (cosplay/prop; nonfunctional). Observed by party. (turns 1268-1276)
Leather tome on shelf: large, plain cover/spine; appears old leather—uncertain if tanned hide or tanned flesh. (turns 1246,1296-1301)
Allura remarks it's her first time adventuring with group; she sighs and comments on their ridiculousness. (turn 1306)
Vax/Vex group examine mysterious book: text shrinks/obscures when viewed closely or in bright light; title also blurred and shrinks. (turns 1327-1331,1341-1348)
Kerr/Patrick Rothfuss activates radiant warhammer: produces bright light that causes book's text to shrink/vanish; hammer emits lightsaber-like sound and brightens room. (turns 1355-1361)
Kerr/Patrick Rothfuss' radiant warhammer's head flickered out after lighting; when hammer removed text became more legible but still blurred. (turns 1355-1361,1374,1394)
Pike's Heroes' Feast had been cast earlier (6th-level) affecting allies; current dialogue references party status post-feast. (turns 296-304,1391)

Keyleth lit brazier with flaming hand; brazier contained extremely explosive materials and detonated, causing area blast: Kerrek (Patrick) and Keyleth failed saves and took 32 fire damage; others took 16 (rogue none). The explosion destroyed the book entirely. (turns 1397-1411,1426-1427)

Pike cast Holy Aura (30-ft radius) as flaming-skulled light sources approach; aura grants advantage on saves and imposes disadvantage on attackers; undead/fiends melee attacks risk CON save to be blinded. (turns 1475-1480)

Basilisk-blood bowl reacted: small drops of party blood were absorbed beneath surface but initially didn't open door; after more interaction the bowl sizzled and burned away, door lifted open; party took 1 point damage from blood loss. (turns 1451-1470)

Four flaming, floating skulls (approx. 4) emerged from hallway sides, cackling and moving toward party; one may have been previously contained in a bag. Initiative rolled immediately after. (turns 1472-1490)
Scanlan cast Invisibility (2nd-level) on himself and moved to northern wall, then held his action. (turns 1532-1536,1538-1541)
Vax moved to opposite wall, flew 10 ft up, threw two daggers (15 and 23 to hit); both hit dealing 19 and 10 damage (total 29). (turns 1542-1554)

Keyleth cast Moonbeam (concentration, up to 1 min, 5-ft radius) targeting two flaming skulls; both failed CON saves and each took 13 radiant damage; one skull was visibly more damaged. (turns 1576-1587)

Four flame skulls fired simultaneous fireballs; everyone except Scanlan made 4 Dex saves with advantage. Consequences: varied damage—Keyleth, Kerrek, Vex saved all (56 fire to those with full saves; Kerrek/Evasion 0), Pike failed two (44 after resistance), Grog/others failed some; Trinket saved one and is stored in Vex's necklace. (turns 1595-1680)
Patrick Rothfuss (Kerr) announced Aura of Divinity grants +3 to saving throws for allies near him; Pike was affected; Grog would have succeeded some saves with it. (turn 1722)

Percival (Scanlan?) used Animus gun + sharpshooter/deadeye to kill two skull-like undead; regained grit points after kills; fired multiple shots, one caused hallway light to extinguish. (turns 1692-1716)
Damage math: Aura of Divinity would have reduced fire save damage by 11 points (half of 22) for affected allies; total prevented damage noted as 56 for all saves combined. (turns 1730-1742)
